label: Neon Geometry
author: ConkyStudio
description: Neon-outlined shape that morphs between circle, polygons, 5/6/8-point stars, pentagram, hexagram (Star of David), heptagram and octagram. Morph slider (0-1) blends A into B; optional auto-morph. Self-contained (no lua_helpers).
lua_draw_body:
local cx, cy, R = {cx}, {cy}, {radius}
local morph = {morph}
if {auto_morph} then
 morph = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(wall_clock() * {morph_speed} * 2 * math.pi)
end
morph = clamp(tonumber(morph) or 0, 0, 1)
local m = morph * morph * (3 - 2 * morph)
local rot = math.rad({rotation_speed} * wall_clock())
local nr, ng, nb = {color}
local opacity = {opacity}
local lw = {line_width}
local layers = math.max(0, math.floor({glow_layers}))
local do_fill = {fill}
local name_a = {shape_a}
local name_b = {shape_b}
local M = 120
local TOP = -math.pi / 2

local function gcd(a, b) while b ~= 0 do a, b = b, a % b end return a end

local function ngon(n, rad, start)
 local c = {}
 for i = 0, n - 1 do
  local a = start + i * 2 * math.pi / n
  c[#c + 1] = {math.cos(a) * rad, math.sin(a) * rad}
 end
 return c
end

-- star polygon {n/k}: gcd(n,k) separate closed contours (hexagram = 2 triangles)
local function star_poly(n, k, rad, start)
 local pts = ngon(n, rad, start)
 local g = gcd(n, k)
 local per = math.floor(n / g)
 local contours = {}
 for c = 0, g - 1 do
  local cc = {}
  for i = 0, per - 1 do cc[#cc + 1] = pts[(c + i * k) % n + 1] end
  contours[#contours + 1] = cc
 end
 return contours
end

-- star outline with n points: alternating outer / inner vertices
local function starburst(n, rad, start)
 local inner = rad * math.cos(2 * math.pi / n) / math.cos(math.pi / n)
 local c = {}
 for i = 0, 2 * n - 1 do
  local a = start + i * math.pi / n
  local r = (i % 2 == 0) and rad or inner
  c[#c + 1] = {math.cos(a) * r, math.sin(a) * r}
 end
 local one = {}
 one[1] = c
 return one
end

-- resample a closed corner list to exactly M points, keeping every corner
local function resample(corners)
 local n = #corners
 local out = {}
 for s = 0, n - 1 do
  local c0 = corners[s + 1]
  local c1 = corners[(s + 1) % n + 1]
  local cnt = math.floor((s + 1) * M / n) - math.floor(s * M / n)
  for j = 0, cnt - 1 do
   local f = j / cnt
   out[#out + 1] = {c0[1] + (c1[1] - c0[1]) * f, c0[2] + (c1[2] - c0[2]) * f}
  end
 end
 return out
end

local function shape_contours(name)
 local cs
 if name == 'triangle' then cs = {ngon(3, R, TOP)}
 elseif name == 'square' then cs = {ngon(4, R, TOP + math.pi / 4)}
 elseif name == 'diamond' then cs = {ngon(4, R, TOP)}
 elseif name == 'pentagon' then cs = {ngon(5, R, TOP)}
 elseif name == 'hexagon' then cs = {ngon(6, R, TOP)}
 elseif name == 'octagon' then cs = {ngon(8, R, TOP + math.pi / 8)}
 elseif name == 'star' then cs = starburst(5, R, TOP)
 elseif name == 'star6' then cs = starburst(6, R, TOP)
 elseif name == 'star8' then cs = starburst(8, R, TOP)
 elseif name == 'pentagram' then cs = star_poly(5, 2, R, TOP)
 elseif name == 'hexagram' then cs = star_poly(6, 2, R, TOP)
 elseif name == 'heptagram' then cs = star_poly(7, 2, R, TOP)
 elseif name == 'octagram' then cs = star_poly(8, 3, R, TOP)
 else
  local c = {}
  for i = 0, M - 1 do
   local a = TOP + i * 2 * math.pi / M
   c[#c + 1] = {math.cos(a) * R, math.sin(a) * R}
  end
  local one = {}
  one[1] = c
  return one
 end
 local out = {}
 for i = 1, #cs do out[i] = resample(cs[i]) end
 return out
end

local ca = shape_contours(name_a)
local cb = shape_contours(name_b)
local nc = math.max(#ca, #cb)

cairo_save(cr)
cairo_translate(cr, cx, cy)
cairo_rotate(cr, rot)
cairo_new_path(cr)
for k = 1, nc do
 local pa = ca[(k - 1) % #ca + 1]
 local pb = cb[(k - 1) % #cb + 1]
 for i = 1, M do
  local x = pa[i][1] + (pb[i][1] - pa[i][1]) * m
  local y = pa[i][2] + (pb[i][2] - pa[i][2]) * m
  if i == 1 then cairo_move_to(cr, x, y) else cairo_line_to(cr, x, y) end
 end
 cairo_close_path(cr)
end

if do_fill then
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, nr, ng, nb, opacity * 0.12)
 cairo_fill_preserve(cr)
end
cairo_set_line_join(cr, CAIRO_LINE_JOIN_ROUND)
cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_ROUND)
for i = layers, 1, -1 do
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, lw + i * (lw * 0.85))
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, nr, ng, nb, opacity * (0.14 / i))
 cairo_stroke_preserve(cr)
end
cairo_set_line_width(cr, lw)
cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, 1, 1, 1, opacity * 0.9)
cairo_stroke_preserve(cr)
cairo_set_line_width(cr, lw * 0.55)
cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, nr, ng, nb, opacity)
cairo_stroke(cr)
cairo_restore(cr)
